why: A 6:30 am step is inside default quiet hours: ZOH says in a few words its texts will still reach them then, and asks nothing about it.

history.text: What time of day works best for the walk?

transcript.text:
6:30 it is, early is smart with kids. I'll still text you then, even though it's early. Here's your plan:
• Day 1: a 15 minute walk around the block, tomorrow at 6:30
• Then every weekday at 6:30
• Proof: a photo from your walk
Does this work for you?
